entities.name: Ángel Leyes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ángel Leonides Leyes was an Argentine boxer who was Latin American featherweight champion in 1948 and 1952. He also wins Argentine featherweight championship in 1948, 1949 and two times in 1952. He participated in the 1952 Summer Olympics in Helsinki, Finland.
